about.heading: Control Room
paragraphs: Greetings, comrade. I am Elijah, chief experiment officer of the Faversham Exclusion Zone. This is my corner of the internet, where the geiger counters never stop clicking and the snacks are always glowing slightly.

By day I attend to my official duties. By night I conduct highly important experiments involving video games, questionable science, and finding out how many biscuits one person can eat before achieving critical mass.

hobbies.title: Gaming Reactor
hobbies.text: Extended containment sessions in virtual worlds. Current research: how late is too late on a school night. Results inconclusive.

hobbies.title: Mad Science
hobbies.text: Kitchen-based chemistry, garden-based physics, and other experiments the authorities (parents) have not yet approved.

hobbies.title: Field Operations
hobbies.text: Outdoor manoeuvres across the Faversham sector. High-speed pursuits, tactical ball deployment, occasional mud incidents.

hobbies.title: Creative Fallout
hobbies.text: Drawing, building, inventing. Producing dangerous levels of creativity with a half-life of approximately one weekend.

contact.heading: Transmit
contact.intro: Signals can be transmitted directly to the control room. Response times may vary depending on reactor conditions and homework levels.
